name: shared-label-contract
goal: Harness EntityHeader contract excludes the removed shared badge input

evidence: The UI implementation removed the EntityHeader.shared prop and its Shared badge, but the registered EntityHeader contract still documents that input; the user-visible contract page would remain inaccurate.

Existing explorer tests cover rendered badge removal and audio tabs, but no assertion ties EntityHeader's declared contract inputs to its current Svelte props; add a focused regression assertion for the stale input and its badge description.
